method: Web search and direct opening/finding of official Google Search Central and Search Console Help documents; no community advice used for conclusions

sources.title: Page indexing report
sources.supportedInterpretation: A crawled URL can remain unindexed, with future inclusion uncertain. The status alone does not identify a specific defect or require repeated resubmission.
sources.application: Retain the actual body exclusion status; do not invent a quality, canonical or crawl-block diagnosis.

sources.title: URL Inspection tool
sources.supportedInterpretation: Indexed inspection is stored evidence. A successful live fetch does not guarantee index inclusion or predict canonical selection. Current rendered screenshots require the live-test workflow.
sources.application: Keep absent body canonical fields as N/A and separate crawl, observation and public-fetch times; no live test was invoked.

sources.title: How to specify a canonical URL with rel=canonical and other methods
sources.supportedInterpretation: Redirects and canonical annotations are stronger canonicalization signals than sitemap inclusion; consistent internal canonical-owner links support the preference without forcing selection.
sources.application: Preserve the relevant 308 destination, declared canonical, existing owner links and sitemap while awaiting evidence of a newer Google crawl.

sources.title: Creating helpful, reliable, people-first content
sources.supportedInterpretation: Useful original experience and trustworthy evidence matter; a preferred word-count target is not prescribed.
sources.application: Request actual repair documentation rather than adding generic words, invented credentials or relabeled conversion photos.

limits: Guidance explains interpretation, not Google's undisclosed decision for this URL.
Public indexability and on-site improvements do not establish selected canonical, ranking gains or future index inclusion.
